# Causal Market Structure

> TypeScript market structure: confirmed swings, BOS/CHOCH and heuristic order-block zones with point-in-time availability clocks.

Package: @farhadarjmand/causal-market-structure. ESM, Node.js 22+, TypeScript declarations, MIT, zero runtime dependencies.
This file is a compact documentation map, not an assurance that any search engine or AI service indexes it.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/farhad-arjmand/causal-market-structure/blob/main/README.md): installation, example, definitions and limitations.
- [API reference](https://github.com/farhad-arjmand/causal-market-structure/blob/main/docs/API.md): exact input/output contracts and edge cases.
- [Implementation](https://github.com/farhad-arjmand/causal-market-structure/blob/main/src/index.ts): public implementation and exported types.
- [Regression tests](https://github.com/farhad-arjmand/causal-market-structure/blob/main/test/regression.test.mjs): independently reproduced edge cases.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/farhad-arjmand/causal-market-structure/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release-specific behavior changes.
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@farhadarjmand/causal-market-structure): installable releases.

## Constraints

This is not a trade signal generator, execution engine, or a guarantee against look-ahead bias elsewhere in your pipeline.
Examples and tests use synthetic data. No private datasets, credentials, trading service connections or training data are included. For reproducibility, use the installed package version's bundled docs, not changing main-branch documentation.
